messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 3D-style top-down RTS where players expand territory, found cities, attack enemies, deploy nuclear bombs, and win by controlling 80% of the land.

## Requirements
- Implement the game now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Keep mobile controls simple.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using Canvas-drawn isometric terrain and UI, with no external game engine.
- Assumed a 9×9 map, automated Redhaven rival, resource economy, and 80% land-control victory condition.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created game interface and responsive styling.
- Implemented map rendering, tile selection, territory expansion, city founding, attacks, nuclear strikes, rival turns, resource income, and win/loss states.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Installed Playwright Chromium after initial browser launch reported it was missing.

### Active
- Browser check of the running game; no screenshot or interaction test has been completed yet.

### Blocked
- Browser visual verification remains pending; Chromium installation is complete, so no known blocker remains.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`.
2. Inspect the game in-browser, test key actions, and save/read a latest JPEG screenshot (≤1280px wide).
3. Fix any issues found and report assumptions briefly when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic and Canvas map rendering.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The server was started in the background on port 3002.
- Initial `playwright-cli open` failed with “Browser "chromium" is not installed”; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` subsequently completed.

- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly territory-control RTS where players expand, found cities, attack Redhaven, deploy nuclear warheads, and win by controlling 80% of the land.
